# Event Bus Topology

<!-- generated by arch.generators.event_bus; do not hand-edit -->

HydraFlow's `EventBus` fans out **every** published event to all *fan-out* subscribers: an argless `subscribe()` / `subscription()` (`src/events.py`) returns a queue that drains the whole bus. Since ADR-0114 (#10660) a subscriber MAY instead pass an optional per-type filter — `subscribe(types={EventType.X, ...})` — so its queue only receives those types (filtered at publish time, so an ignored high-volume type never fills its bounded slots). The Subscribers column shows `★ all (fan-out)` for every live event, plus any typed consumer that filters on it. An event is flagged ⚠️ (likely dead) only when it is a declared `EventType` with **no publisher** (the live-only `EPHEMERAL_EVENT_TYPES` allowlist is exempt).

**Fan-out consumers** (each receives every published event):

- `src.dashboard_routes._routes:create_router.websocket_endpoint`
- `src.dashboard_routes._ws_stream:_serve_merged_ws`
